articles.summary: First Horizon Corporation (NYSE: FHN or "First Horizon") is pleased to announce that Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Hope Dmuchowski has been named to American Banker's 2026 Most Powerful Women in Banking™ list for the third consecutive year. The annual recognition honors women leaders for their contributions to the banking and financial services industry. "This well-deserved recognition reflects Hope's exceptional leadership and impact across the company," said Bryan Jordan, Chairman of the Board, President and CEO of First Horizon. "From strengthening our financial position and capital strategy to modernizing our finance organization and helping shape our Five Flag strategic framework to establishing clear priorities across the organization, Hope brings a forward-looking approach to the CFO role and a strong focus on disciplined execution. articles.title: American Banker Names Hope Dmuchowski to 2026 Most Powerful Women in Banking™ List
